Overview

Gabrovo is a city in Gabrovo with a population of 58,950. The Bulgarian capital of humour and satire, home to the House of Humour and Satire museum, and a gateway to the UNESCO-listed Bozhentsi and Etara architectural reserves. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
